text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, seems like everyone is gotten into
the
Valentine's spirit!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This heart-racing holiday only comes
once a year!
Of course everyone's
excited! Are you not, Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's nobody you want to
confess your
love to, you can still
exchange chocolates with
your friends,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, consider me to be on the
receiving
end! It's like my dad used to
tell me...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Just like how I give gifts to your mom,
someday
you'll find a wonderful person
who will shower you
with sweet treats
too!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! So in your family, your father is
the one
who gives gifts to your mother?
That's so lovely!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Of course, my mom would always
repay the
gesture with loads of love!
That's how they do it
in America!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Does that mean you already have

someone who spoils you with sweet
treats?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea! Hehe! Well then, you have
to make
sure to properly return that love
in full, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, she's right. It's my duty to return
the
favor after receiving a gift... meaning
I'll have to
prepare something too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mom would always give Dad a peck on
the cheek,
but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Non, non! Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing here?! The main
event isn't
until tomorrow! What are you
doing, trying to
jump the gun?! I should
disqualify you for that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was merely passing by when I heard
Seeking the
Pearl yell, but it's rare to
see her so
uncharacteristically flustered.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why, what passion in your eyes! You
must be very
excited to receive
something from me. That's only
natural,
of course.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But use your head, please. My parents'

relationship with each other is not
synonymous
with the one you and I
share.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
However, I am Seeking the Pearl! As
someone
who stands atop the world, I
must always be
ready to meet people's
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Especially since we're partners.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Just be patient. I'll get
everything in
order before tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl walks away, leaving
me utterly
nonplussed. What on earth
could be happening
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Well? This should be a more
than
suitable response to your feelings,
no?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is what you would call
American-sized!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just as I said yesterday, we're
Umamusume and
trainer! Considering
that, this seemed like the
best option!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate Seeking the Pearl lugs
into the
room is so immense, I don't even
think I can fully
wrap my arms around it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! It's a thank-you for your
present!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...The present that you haven't given to
me yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Could she have been expecting me to
give her
something for Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Ohohoho! Well, it appears that I was the one who jumped the gun!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No problem! You'll just have to be the one to return the favor this time around!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very good! Now, what kind of thank-you
present
have you thought up for me to
reciprocate this
amount of chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well? Well?! Where's my thank-you
gift?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl inches uncomfortably
close to
me, so I calm her down and
convince her to give
me a moment to
prepare her a return gift.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After yesterday's bizarre encounter with
Seeking
the Pearl, I looked up the date
and realized it was
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing fancy, but I decided to get
her a
seashell-shaped box of chocolates
that happened
to catch my eye. I hope
she likes them.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Goodness. This is a fabulous gift.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of giving you a hug in
return, but
that wouldn't possibly be
enough for such a lovely
present.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Non! Someone like me could never just
accept a
gift without properly giving
something in return!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But right now, I have nothing... Ngh, how
could I
let this happen!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very well! I'll just have to pay you back
for
today's Valentine's gift in the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Right now we're Umamusume and
trainer.
Considering that relationship,
there's only so
much we can do for each
other at present.
However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The future holds endless possibilities!
Possibilities
not yet known!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So get ready to meet your baker!
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although her choice and version of
idiom doesn't
really match the situation,
I let it slide. She turns
aside and
continues laughing loudly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's just my imagination, but I
swear I see
her cheeks flushing behind
the hair shielding her
face from view.
